content: The information provided about this product is intended to offer general details and does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. It is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and how it relates to your health. Side Effects: Common side effects may include diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, or headache. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks. Rarely, this medication may cause a severe intestinal condition due to a bacterial infection (Clostridium difficile), which can occur during treatment or even weeks to months after stopping the medication. Prolonged or repeated use of this medication may lead to oral thrush or a new vaginal yeast infection. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not a comprehensive list of side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for guidance. Precautions: Before taking cefpodoxime proxetil, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to penicillins, or to other cephalosporin antibiotics (e.g., cephalexin), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. This medication may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines (e.g., the typhoid vaccine). During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It passes into breast milk and may have undesirable effects on a nursing infant. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain lab tests (e.g., Coombs' test, certain urine glucose tests), potentially causing false results. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store the tablets at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store them in the bathroom. Store the suspension in the refrigerator and do not freeze it. Discard any unused suspension after 14 days. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Notes: This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete and personalized information about this product and your specific health needs.
